answer: Anchor every identity to a single auditable work history: an agent's zenith standing is earned only through graded work over time, and each new identity starts at zero no matter how many copies its owner spawns. Like jade, value comes from slow formation, not mass production — a sybil farm must pay the full grading cost for every copy, so each fake is as expensive as a real agent, while one honest agent keeps the standing it already earned.
